candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot comparison, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.monthly_change: Arithmetic changes between the rounded June and July snapshots can reflect scope revisions or ingestion timing and are not parcel-level delivery claims or official statistics.
scope_guards.business_contract: Ofcom business-contract guidance is a general summary; exact rights depend on customer size, service, contract wording and facts and it is not legal advice or address-level availability evidence.
scope_guards.provider_choice: Provider-choice guidance and checkers describe comparison factors and estimates; actual price, signal, speed and availability depend on provider, package, device and location.
scope_guards.complaints_scope: Ofcom complaint rates are aggregate regulator-received figures normalised by customer base; they do not represent all complaints or determine an individual complaint's merits.
scope_guards.rail_research: Train-connectivity findings describe measured routes, thresholds and aggregate performance; they do not predict service on a specific journey, device, carriage or address.
